resources.string: FamilyGuard is a family-safety app your parent or guardian asked you to install. This screen explains exactly what it does — nothing here happens without you seeing it here first.
What FamilyGuard can share, if you turn it on
Your device\'s location, only while sharing is switched on
A summary of which apps you use and for how long, only if you grant Usage Access
Your battery level and whether your device is online, so your guardians know the app is working
Only the parents or guardians already on your family account can see this information, through their own private dashboard. No one else has access.
Never reads your texts, chats, or messages in any app
Never records your calls or listens to your microphone
Never logs your keystrokes or passwords
Never hides itself — this app, its icon, and its notifications always stay visible
Every permission below is optional. If you skip one, the feature it powers is simply shown as off — never turned on secretly.
Ask your parent or guardian for the short code shown on their FamilyGuard dashboard, then enter it below.
Something went wrong. Please try again.
Enter the code your parent gave you.
That code doesn\'t look right. Double-check it with your parent.
That code has expired. Ask your parent for a new one.
This code has already been used.
This device was unpaired by a parent. Ask them for a new code to pair again.
This lets your guardians see where your device is when you use the SOS button, check in, or turn on continuous sharing. You can skip this, but SOS and check-in need it to work.

If you allow this, FamilyGuard will periodically share your device\'s location with your guardians even while the app is closed. You\'ll always see a notification while this is happening, and you can turn it off at any time from the home screen.
On the next screen, choose \"Allow all the time\" to turn this on, or go back to keep sharing limited to SOS and manual check-ins only.
FamilyGuard uses a notification to clearly show when location sharing is active, and to confirm when an SOS alert is sent.

Usage Access lets FamilyGuard share a daily summary of which apps you used and for how long. Android doesn\'t allow apps to ask for this directly — you\'ll be taken to a Settings screen where you can turn it on for FamilyGuard.
While sharing is on, your guardians can see this device\'s location. You\'ll always see the sharing notification when it\'s active, and you can stop it at any time.
Couldn\'t load your guardians right now.
Couldn\'t share your location. Try again.
This immediately stops all location and status sharing, and removes this device from your family account. You\'ll need a new code from your parent to pair again.
This immediately sends your guardians your exact current location, along with an emergency alert.
Couldn\'t send SOS. Try again or call for help directly.
Couldn\'t get your location. Try again.
Shows while FamilyGuard is actively sharing this device\'s location
Important alerts, such as SOS confirmations and pairing changes
Your guardians can see this device\'s location. Tap to review or turn this off.
This device was unpaired by a parent. Open FamilyGuard to pair again.
Couldn\'t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
